name: Minowa
tagline: Tokyo in 16 minutes and Otemachi in 22 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000.
summary: The station is in Taito City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 22 minutes to Otemachi, 33 minutes to Shinjuku, 41 minutes to Shibuya and 30 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. The station stands 3.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.6 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 3.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 0.9 m to 3.5 m, a difference of 2.6 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. All nine points within 400 m of the station fall inside the area too, and the deepest projection among them is 3 to 5 m. For storm surge, 6 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the large side for the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 25 clinics and 17 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 木村病院, about 8 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 上宮会日暮里上宮病院, about 10 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line runs at 163% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 三ノ輪→入谷, which includes this station. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥100,000 to ¥110,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the low side. What holds the figure down: a large projected flood depth and only one line, the {line}, serving the station. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Minowabashi is ahead on quiet, but Minowa is ahead on how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Minowa. It takes 11 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Minowa. One-room rents run about ¥6,000 lower.

leads.groceries: There are 17 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
